lines.zh: 我半走半站，后腿撑得高。
lines.en: Half walk, half stand. Hind legs high.

lines.zh: 我原来被当成恐龙的祖先。
lines.en: They once thought I fathered the dinosaurs.
Short steps. Steady.
Low to the ground. Like a crocodile.
Short forelimbs. I lean forward to walk.

lines.zh: 我走得很快，几步就到你面前。
lines.en: Quick. A few strides and I'm there.
Triassic stone. I know it.
My tail drags and swings.
I can run a stretch, then stop.

lines.zh: 我绕过石头，眼里只有前面。
lines.en: I round a boulder. Eyes forward.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，从低处过去。
lines.en: I flatten and go under.

lines.zh: 我在林缘走，那里有猎物。
lines.en: I walk the forest edge. Prey there.
Step by step, toes gripping.
I move diagonally, hunting cover.
I prop on my forelimbs and look up.

lines.zh: 我的牙往外长，不好合嘴。
lines.en: My teeth stick out. Hard to close my mouth.

lines.zh: 我趴在暖石上，尾巴慢慢摆。
lines.en: I lie on a warm stone, tail swinging slowly.

lines.zh: 我在等，等一个不合适的人。
lines.en: Waiting. For someone careless.

lines.zh: 我蹲伏着，看起来很安静。
lines.en: Crouched. Looks calm.
Counting nearby heartbeats.

lines.zh: 我当年被当成恐龙祖先。
lines.en: They once took me for a dinosaur's ancestor.
Thick hide. Very old.

lines.zh: 我慢慢歪头，一只眼对着你。
lines.en: I tilt my head. One eye on you.

lines.zh: 我没有恐龙的骨头，但很像。
lines.en: I don't have a dinosaur's bones. I look like one.
I've stood in this wood a long while.

lines.zh: 我抬腿，活动了一下脚踝。
lines.en: I lift a leg and work the ankle.
Bugs crawl on my back.
I lower my head and sniff the ground.

lines.zh: 你站得很直，那是坏习惯。
lines.en: You stand upright. Bad habit.

lines.zh: 我这样看你，是低着头的。
lines.en: I look at you from lowered eyes.

lines.zh: 你身上有热，我在算距离。
lines.en: You're warm. I'm calculating distance.

lines.zh: 我的牙露在外面，你注意到了。
lines.en: My teeth show. You noticed.
If you don't move, I'll get closer.

lines.zh: 你举武器的手抬得太高了。
lines.en: The hand raising your weapon is far too high.
You're tall. I look from below.
Your ankle. I've looked a long time.
When you turn, I move.
This distance. It suits me.

lines.zh: 你把武器举起来，太慢了。
lines.en: You raised a weapon. Too slow.

lines.zh: 我不是恐龙，但我不介意。
lines.en: I'm not a dinosaur. I don't mind.
I backed off and flattened again.
My flank twitches; I crouch lower.
My hind leg quivers, my teeth still set.
I can still lunge with this.
I shake my head. Teeth intact.
Faster than me. Rare.
Half a step back. Circling.
Thick hide. Still hurts inside.
More careful now.
You've given me an angle.
Meat. The raw kind.
On the ground. Don't hand it over.
I smelled it. From far off.
Hold it. I might take the hand.
My forelimbs are short. Can't reach high.
On the ground. Three steps back.
That's worth one lunge.

lines.zh: 我得先绕一圈，看有没有别人。
lines.en: First I circle. Check for others.
I eat fast. Don't watch.

lines.zh: 这块肉小，我一口就没了。
lines.en: That meat is small; one bite finishes it.
You touched me and I flinched in.

lines.zh: 你踢到我下巴，我偏开头。
lines.en: Your kick catches my jaw; I turn aside.
I held through that.
I go around. No contact.

lines.zh: 你的脚踩到了我的尾巴。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail.

lines.zh: 我撞上去的时候没有声音。
lines.en: My charge made no sound.

lines.zh: 我们挨得太近了，这对你不好。
lines.en: Too close. Bad for you.
I slipped aside. Smooth.

lines.zh: 地上的土被我们弄乱了。
lines.en: We've churned the soil.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的肩撞到你了。
lines.en: My shoulder caught you.
On my own is enough.
My kind isn't particular.
First, can you hold your ground.
I crouch and circle.
If you're afraid, stop pretending.
This territory is enough for one.
I don't wait. I leave.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的规矩，谁快谁得。
lines.en: Triassic rules. Fastest takes it.
Don't put a hand on my back.

lines.zh: 低头看着你，这姿势保持住。
lines.en: I'll keep my head down and watch.
I bite it and shake.
I pin it with a forelimb.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我从不放过。
lines.en: I never pass up what's on the ground.
It doesn't bleed. Pass.
I carry it back into the trees.

lines.zh: 它划破了我的嘴，我甩掉。
lines.en: It cut my mouth. I shook it off.
One sniff. A bit old.
You dropped it. Mine now.
My teeth don't meet. It fell.
I don't cache. I eat.

lines.zh: 苏格兰的伪鳄，听见了那声脆响。
lines.en: The Scottish pseudosuchian heard that snap.
I've flattened down.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我第一次就能到。
lines.en: This distance. First try.

lines.zh: 我锁定你的时候，你没察觉。
lines.en: You didn't notice when I locked on.

lines.zh: 这片林子没有别的猎物。
lines.en: No other prey in these trees.

lines.zh: 你的影子很长，我能看见。
lines.en: Your shadow is long. I can see it.
One stride puts me at your feet.

lines.zh: 我数过了，你退三步就到树。
lines.en: Three steps back and you hit a tree.
Chosen. Don't waste effort.
Your blood runs fast.
I approach slow. Don't want to alarm.
One move is all.
My teeth are showing more.

lines.zh: 你踩在苔上，声音很轻可我听。
lines.en: You step on moss, quiet, but I hear.
I keep shortening the gap.
You retreat. My snout follows slowly.
In the tree shadow. I see you.
Short forelimbs. You're slower.
That in your hand. I've seen it.
My tail holds my balance.
You looked back. I froze.

lines.zh: 你在树影里绕，我也在绕。
lines.en: You circle in the tree shadows; so do I.
Waiting for your foot to land.
Your breathing is too loud.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的猎手，我是其中之一。
lines.en: One of the Triassic hunters. That's me.

lines.zh: 我靠近的时候，地面不响。
lines.en: The ground doesn't speak as I near.

lines.zh: 你再退一步，就来不及了。
lines.en: One more step and it's too late.
Mouth open. Every tooth out.
This is the lunge.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，咬住你的小腿。
lines.en: I lunge. Teeth in your calf.
My teeth don't meet. They still tear.
That put you on the ground.
A forelimb hooks your clothes.
I shake my head and wrench you off balance.
You kicked. I pulled back.
Shallow bite.
That lunge used all my legs had.
You're down. I press in.
I lunge and hook my foreclaws on your waist.
The blood smell speeds me up.
You blocked. Three steps back.
That's my only move.
I'm back around.
I stand up out of the brush.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，先看清附近。
lines.en: I crouch and read the area.
Triassic weather. Hot.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的苏格兰，我跑得快。
lines.en: In Triassic Scotland, I ran fast.
Forelimbs braced. Waiting for you.
Two steps. Stop. Look up.
This forest edge is my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我从土里出来，身上还湿。
lines.en: I come out of the soil, still damp.

lines.zh: 枯叶下面，我慢慢抬起头。
lines.en: Under the dead leaves I slowly raise my head.
I crouch. Barely moving.
I picked a spot by a large tree.
My shadow lies flat on the ground.

lines.zh: 我从蕨根间爬出来，满身土。
lines.en: I crawl out from the fern roots, caked in dirt.

lines.zh: 这片林子有猎物的味道。
lines.en: This wood smells of prey.

lines.zh: 我低伏着，从这一头到那一头。
lines.en: Low and moving, from one end to the other.
I landed light. No sound.
No other predators here.
I lever myself up, slowly.

lines.zh: 火烤过来，我往林子里钻。
lines.en: Fire. I head into the trees.
Dropped from height. Legs numb.

lines.zh: 我不该进深水，脚够不到底。
lines.en: Shouldn't be in deep water. No footing.

lines.zh: 炸得我贴在地上起不来。
lines.en: The blast pinned me down.

lines.zh: 后腿中了一下，我拖不动。
lines.en: My hind leg's hit. I can't pull.

lines.zh: 这力量让我的腿僵住了。
lines.en: That power stiffened my legs.

lines.zh: 林子里空了，我饿得发抖。
lines.en: The wood's empty. I'm shaking with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷打在林子里，我全身一紧。
lines.en: Lightning in the trees. My whole body clenched.

lines.zh: 往下掉，爪子什么也抓不住。
lines.en: Falling. Claws catch nothing.
